_specs: Nothing about construction is published for the hats. The family file marks fabric and care as needing spec; nothing is invented here.
buyBody: The mark inverted, on cream. It is the one people look at twice, and cream sits better against a course than white does in strong light.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Cream against green — the contrast is the shot. Golfer in profile so the inverted mark is unmistakably the right way up on the hat and the wrong way up as a mark. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
